Column Guide

Player
Canonical lowercase player key from the project's naming table. Identity is resolved before any pricing — ambiguous names are excluded, never guessed.
Source
Which publisher the value comes from: fantasycalc_adjusted, fantasypros_adjusted, usatoday_adjusted, cbsros, espn, etc. The _adjusted suffix means as-published values run through the adjustment-cell refit.
Season
NFL season year (e.g., 2026).
Week
NFL week number (1–18). All weeks are retained — no aging out.
Scoring
League scoring: full (Full PPR), half (Half PPR), standard (no PPR).
Teams
League size: 8, 10, 12, or 14 teams.
QB
QB variant — only applies to FantasyCalc sources (qb1/qb2). All other sources show blank.
View
Which value family: combo_reindexed = chart-ready values after pie indexation; vorp_indexed / vorp / adj_values = VORP translation outputs.
Value
The exact final value — stored unrounded in consolidation. Rounding happens in presentation only.
